paragraphs: I'm applying for the Senior Developer role supporting Yempo's Australian commercial property client. My day-to-day work already sits at the intersection this role needs: .NET Core/Web API backends, Angular frontends, and Azure cloud services.

At Delta Insurance, I drive end-to-end development and release execution across a 5-microservice .NET Core backend paired with a React frontend, alongside managing cloud infrastructure on AWS (API Gateways, Parameter Store). Earlier, at Punongbayan & Araullo, I built and maintained internal web applications using ASP.NET, C#, and Angular, and used Azure DevOps for source control, code reviews, and CI/CD pipelines — the same Angular + .NET Core + Azure DevOps combination this role is built around.
I'd be glad to bring that same ownership to your client's intranet and internal tooling. Thank you for considering my application — I'm available to start on short notice.
